{{family name hatnote|San Nicolás|Schellens|lang=Catalan}}
'''Moisés San Nicolás Schellens''' (born 17 September 1993) is an Andorran [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Defender (association football)|centre back, right back]] or [[Midfielder (association football)|right midfielder]] for [[FC Santa Coloma]] in the [[Primera Divisió]].<ref>{{Soccerway|moises-san-nicolas/134284}}</ref>

==International career==
San Nicolás was born in Andorra to an Andorran father and Belgian mother. He plays for the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.proximus.be/pickx/fr/2384072/trebel-amat-walsh-ces-doubles-nationalites-etonnantes|title=Trebel, Amat, Walsh… Ces doubles nationalités étonnantes|website=www.proximus.be}}</ref>
